topic_zh: 按帧索引的原生离线视频导出
scope: Actual local VP9 encode/decode, WebM playback and render/encode/mux elapsed; no neural video, GPU-stage isolation, calibrated quality or hardware-codec guarantee.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating warmed runs per path, 24 frames per export. Elapsed includes rendering, native encoding and muxing, excludes rig setup, decode and display. prefer-software is a hint, not a hardware audit.

protocol.function: frame index → exact scene time → offscreen pixels → native VP9 → WebM → native decode and playback

robustness.name: Flush policy preserves submitted frame count

good_fit: Separating scene state from delivery format
